debate.key_bear_argument: RSI 77 + Stoch 89.7 + negative CMF/AO + weak ADX 23 + crisis VIX + unfavourable macro (-3) + zero fundamental support + no strategy triggered = overbought technicals in hostile macro environment with high pullback risk and no institutional conviction.
